title: Bleeding Heart SMP
description: A unique hardcore server with a 30M world border, the Farlands, One Mace as well as reviving people if you build a shrine with their head!
body:
JAVA 1.21.11 | HARDCORE | The only hardcore server with a 30M world border, the Far Lands and Vanilla Redstone! No pay-to-win crap, only fun hardcore in a growing community.

Bleeding Heart SMP is a hardcore vanilla experience where every decision matters. One death can end your run unless another player recovers your head and revives you at a shrine. So far, over 1800 people joined, with over 1000 of them dying trying to reach greatness. The world is almost endless, with the Far Lands over 12 million blocks out, fully accessible for those who dare to explore.

We stay true to technical vanilla: TNT duping, gravity duping, and redstone contraptions all work as they were intended. Crystal PvP is disabled, making combat rely on timing, movement, and actual player skill.

A few things make this server uniquely chaotic (in a good way):

✔ Reachable Far Lands — not many servers let you travel this far.

✔ Buildable Orbital Strike Cannon — ever wanted to get your hands on this powerful weapon?

✔ One single mace exists in the world — whoever has it becomes a legend.

✔ Revival shrines let players bring others back… if they’re willing.

✔ Small, growing community where actions actually shape the world.

If you're looking for a world where survival, exploration, and player stories feel meaningful, this is the right place. Come write the first chapters of a server that’s still becoming itself.
